// diagnostic

E1006

`use core.*` import or emitted helper exceeds package `runtime:` ceiling

What

`use core.*` import or emitted helper exceeds package `runtime:` ceiling

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Replace the `use core.*` import or helper with one below the package `runtime:` ceiling.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1006: tests/ui/layer_ceiling_exceeded/stderr.

Error [jet.RuntimeCeilingExceeded]: `core.files` needs `runtime: hosted`
  --> tests/ui/layer_ceiling_exceeded/run.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | use fs: core.files
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: This package declares `runtime: core` in `package.jet`, which caps imports at the `core` runtime profile; `core.files` needs `hosted`; import chain: `use core.files`
 Fix: Remove the import or helper use, raise the ceiling to `runtime: hosted` in `package.jet`, or use a `core` runtime alternative
